gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-inscripti: Expressive and loud, Autour One lays down a minimal step from capitals to lowercase. Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian follows in a plain sans with wide-open eyes on every e and a, so long paragraphs stay easy on the eye.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-jp: Chunky, round and unshaded, Autour One makes the first move. Noto Sans JP brings a very tall x-height and curves that sweep open, which is the quality that really carries this pairing.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Noto Sans Kaithi fills the line with lowercase forms that stand almost as tall as capitals, each e keeping its channel open. Autour One sits above it with a ballpoint-like stroke, so the two read as one voice.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Noto Sans Kannada keeps a gentle bump between small letters and capitals, and its s curves open wide at both ends. But if Autour One were shrunk down to small sizes, its bold, evenly weighted strokes would lose their punch.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Noto Sans Kayah Li lifts its brush ends away before each curve closes, and its capitals barely rise over the lowercase. Autour One, with an unmodulated line through every glyph, gives that quiet sans a loud, round partner above it.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-kharoshth: Autour One is expressive and bold, its bowls as heavy as its stems. Noto Sans Kharoshthi counters with curves that never close back on themselves, and that open-versus-heavy tension is the pair's best trait.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Round, loud and marker-drawn, Autour One goes first. Noto Sans Khmer answers with generous openings like chisel notches and small letters standing proud, which gives the pair its strongest quality.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Fat, round and confident, Autour One leads with a steady, unshaded outline. Noto Sans Khojki follows in a clean sans with a large eye on every e, so a longer passage lets light through.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Friendly and clean, this body font keeps capitals and lowercase close in height, with rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook. Noto Sans Khudawadi against the thick, thread-like line of Autour One makes the pair's strongest quality: a soft body under a bold head.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-kr: Contemporary and tidy, Noto Sans KR keeps its curves generous. Autour One shouts in one steady outline above it, while the body's big x-height and stubby ascenders settle each page below.
